category_title: Students with learning disabilities exhibiting low motivation, poor frustration tolerance, and resistance to academic demands
scenario_title: Whole-class instruction and guided questioning on new material
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class lecture and guided questioning session about new material.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to go over the new material on the screen. Please look at the first slide and tell me what you see.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps head down, not looking at the instructor or the media on the screen.) I don't see anything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to look at the screen to answer the question. What do you think it says?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I don't want to read it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give it a try and follow along with the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets out of the seat and speaks loudly, interrupting the instruction) I said I don't know! This is too hard and I'm not doing it!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are going to go over the new material on the screen. Please look at the first slide and tell me what you see.

STUDENT: (Keeps head down, not looking at the instructor or the media on the screen.) I don't see anything.

TUTOR: You need to look at the screen to answer the question. What do you think it says?

STUDENT: I don't know. I don't want to read it.

TUTOR: Just give it a try and follow along with the rest of the class.

STUDENT: (Gets out of the seat and speaks loudly, interrupting the instruction) I said I don't know! This is too hard and I'm not doing it!

task.content: Learning the day's content through demonstrations, lecture, explicit teaching, media, and guided questioning

context.social_setting: Whole class instruction led by the general education teacher

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When learning new material without enough opportunities to interact with educational material under the guidance of classroom teachers
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Not sitting in seat while verbally responding to teacher questions, not actively engaged in answering instructor's question, not looking at instructor while instructor was talking

behavior_patterns.condition: When presented with academic demands during whole group instruction
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Interrupting instruction, displaying resistance to academic demands
